## flow-status

Governs: `src/main/flow/** src/renderer/flow/**`

- {**F1** Where a change's the workspaces spec has no `## Verification criteria` heading, Atril shall show the stage Entrada. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts proposal}
- {**F2** Where it has `## Verification criteria` and no `## Approach`, Atril shall show Spec. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts criteria}
- {**F3** Where it has `## Approach` and its checklist holds no box, Atril shall show Plan. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts approach}
- {**F4** Where its checklist holds at least one open box, Atril shall show Construir with closed / total and the first open box. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts open}
- {**F5** Where every box is closed and the change folder still exists, Atril shall show Terminado sin aterrizar. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts all}
- {**F6** Where the workspace has `.agents/`, no change folder, and commits ahead of its base commit, Atril shall show Aterrizado. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts no}
- {**F7** The checklist reader shall ignore boxes inside a code fence, and in the workspaces spec boxes outside `## Checklist`. src/main/flow/checklist.test.ts fenced}
- {**F8** When a change's files change on disk, Atril shall update the stage within one second. src/main/flow/watch.test.ts file}
- {**F9** If a workspace has no `.agents/` directory, then Atril shall show "sin Libretto". src/main/flow/stage.test.ts no}
- {**F10** Where the workspace has `.agents/` but no change folder and no commits ahead of its base commit, Atril shall show Entrada. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts fresh}
- {**F11** When `.agents/` appears in a workspace that showed "sin Libretto", Atril shall show its stage within one second. src/main/flow/watch.test.ts agents}
- {**F12** Where several change folders exist, Atril shall show the most recently modified one and list the others. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts several}
- {**F13** When the person clicks Spec, Plan or Checklist in the Libretto panel, Atril shall open a modal over the app with the current change's `proposal.md` (and, for Spec, one more file tab per `spec-*.md`), with the cursor at that part's heading — Spec: the first level-2 heading; Plan: `## Approach`; Checklist: `## Checklist`, found outside code fences as in F1–F7 — and each shall be a button only from its stage on: Spec from Spec, Plan from Plan, Checklist once a checklist exists; Escape or Cerrar shall close it, asking first when there are unsaved changes. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts stage}
- {**F14** While a document is open with no unsaved changes, it shall show the file's new text within one second of the agent changing it, even when the stage does not change. src/main/flow/document.test.ts an}
- {**F15** While the agent's known state is working, the editor shall be read-only and its status bar shall say «solo lectura · Claude está escribiendo»; otherwise the person shall type into it, its file tab shall show a dot while there are unsaved changes, and ⌘S or Guardar shall save the whole file; if the save is refused, the person's text shall stay in the editor with the reason shown above it. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts edit}
- {**F16** If a save arrives while the agent's state read at that moment is working («Claude está escribiendo: no se ha guardado»), or names a change that is not a folder under `.agents/changes/` or a file other than `proposal.md` or `spec-<name>.md` directly in it («Ese archivo no se puede editar desde Atril»), or the file's mtime differs from the one it was read with («Claude ha cambiado el archivo mientras editabas: copia tu texto y vuelve a abrirlo»), then Atril shall write nothing and return that message; otherwise it shall replace the file atomically. src/main/flow/document.test.ts save}
- {**F17** The editor's colouring shall build headings, list markers, boxes, code and bold as React text nodes, so markup in the file (`<script>`, `<img onerror>`) shows as literal characters. src/renderer/flow/documents.test.ts markdown}
- {**F18** The change list shall contain every file that differs from the workspace's base commit — committed, uncommitted, and untracked-but-not-ignored — each with its status (A, M or D; a rename as D of the old path and A of the new) and its added and removed line counts (0 and 0 for a binary file, tracked or untracked). src/main/flow/changes.test.ts lists}
- {**F19** If the diff is asked for a path that is not in that workspace's change list, then Atril shall return no text without running any git command for that path. src/main/flow/changes.test.ts diff}
- {**F23** If a file's diff is longer than 1 MB (UTF-8 bytes), then Atril shall cut it at the last line break before 1 MB and end it with the line «Diff recortado a 1 MB». src/main/flow/changes.test.ts a}
- {**F24** Atril shall pass every listed name to git as a literal path (no glob or `:(` magic), and shall count an untracked symbolic link as one line without opening its target. src/main/flow/changes.test.ts names}
- {**F20** While the stage is Construir, Terminado or Aterrizado and the list is not empty, the Libretto panel shall show «Cambios» with each file's status and +/− counts, the total of added plus removed lines, and Construir as a button reading «ver N archivos»; at earlier stages Construir shall not be a button and no «Cambios» section shall appear. src/renderer/flow/changes.test.ts changes}
- {**F21** When the person clicks Construir or a file in Cambios, Atril shall open a read-only modal with the changed files listed and the chosen file's diff — a snapshot with its time and an «Actualizar» button — its added and removed lines marked as such and rendered as text only; Escape shall close it. src/renderer/flow/changes.test.ts a}
- {**F22** While the stage is Construir or later, Atril shall ask for the list again every 3 seconds, skipping a tick while the previous request has not answered. src/renderer/flow/changes.test.ts the}
- {**F25** While the change list totals more than the hook's threshold (400), «Cambios» shall show, in place of the plain total, a warning element (class `fbig`) reading «⚠ N líneas: rama grande (más de 400). Atril le ha pedido a Claude que te proponga separarla en MRs más pequeñas.» src/renderer/flow/changes.test.ts a}

## settings

Governs: `src/main/credentials/** src/renderer/settings/**`

- {**S1** When a token is saved, Atril shall store it encrypted with `safeStorage` in `~/.atril/secrets.bin`, and the file shall not contain the token in clear. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts saved}
- {**S2** If `safeStorage` encryption is unavailable, then Atril shall refuse to save and say why. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts refuses}
- {**S3** No IPC response, log line or file other than `secrets.bin` shall ever contain a saved token. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts token}
- {**S4** When the Jira token is saved, Atril shall check it with `/rest/api/3/myself` and show the account name, or the service's error without the token. src/main/credentials/check.test.ts check}
- {**S5** While a token is stored, the Ajustes card shall show "Guardado" with the account and offer only Reemplazar and Borrar, never the token. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts saved}
- {**S6** If a feature needs a service with no token, it shall show "Conecta <servicio> en Ajustes" with a link to that card. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts missing}
- {**S7** When the person presses «Crear token en Atlassian», Atril shall open Atlassian's API token page in the default browser and nothing else. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts create}
- {**S8** While a Jira token is saved, the top bar shall show the account's avatar and display name from `/rest/api/3/myself`; the avatar is fetched by the main process and reaches the renderer as image data only, never with the token; clicking the chip opens Ajustes. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts top}
- {**S9** When the person searches and picks a board in Ajustes, Atril shall store its id and name, and show it on the Jira card. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts picks}
- {**S10** When the Jira token is replaced, Atril shall keep the picked board; when it is deleted, Atril shall forget the board too. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts board}
- {**S11** While Ajustes is shown, the Repos card shall list every registered repo with its id, its path and a mode select offering «Auto · <detected mode>», «Worktree» and «In-place»; choosing «Worktree» or «In-place» shall store it as the repo's mode (W4), choosing «Auto» shall clear it, and the select shall show the choice; a repo detected as in-place shall show the reason under its path. src/renderer/settings/repos.test.ts repos}
- {**S12** When the person adds a repo from the card and its id is taken, the card shall ask for another id and register it with the one given. src/renderer/settings/repos.test.ts adding}
- {**S13** If the folder the person picks is not a git repository, then the card shall say «Esa carpeta no es un repositorio git.» and register nothing. src/renderer/settings/repos.test.ts a}
- {**S14** While Ajustes is shown, the Idioma card shall offer Español, English and Sistema, show the stored choice selected — Sistema when none was made — and store a new choice when picked. src/renderer/settings/language.test.ts language}
- {**S15** When the person picks English, the window shall show Atril's own texts in English at once — the rail, Trabajo, Tareas, Ajustes and the Nueva tarea dialog — without a restart. src/renderer/settings/language.test.ts the}
- {**S16** Every literal key passed to `t()` or `translate()` in `src/` shall have an English entry, no key shall be a template literal, and the catalog shall hold no entry that no call uses. src/preload/i18n.test.ts every}
- {**S17** While the language is English, texts Atril did not write — an activity line, a Jira title, a file name, the detail inside an error — shall be shown exactly as they came. src/renderer/settings/language.test.ts claude}
- {**S19** Outside tests and the catalog, no string literal or JSX text in `src/` containing á, é, í, ó, ú, ñ, ü, ¿, ¡ or « shall reach the person without going through `t()` or `translate()`. (Ceiling named: a Spanish text with none of these letters is caught only by S15's screens or by reading.) src/preload/i18n.test.ts no}
- {**S20** When the person saves a GitHub token, or a GitLab `https://` address and token, Atril shall check it against the forge's `/user` and store it only on a 2xx answer, then show the account name and never the token; on any other status it shall show «{forge} ha rechazado el token ({status}). No se ha guardado.», on a network failure «No se ha podido conectar con {forge} ({detail}).», and for a GitLab address that is not `https://` «La dirección de GitLab debe empezar por https://» — storing nothing in all three. src/main/credentials/forge.test.ts a}
- {**S23** While Público is chosen, Crear shall stay disabled until the person ticks «Entiendo que cualquiera podrá verlo». src/renderer/settings/createrepo.test.ts a}
- {**S25** The forge status answers sent to the window shall carry `saved`, the account and the address, and nothing derived from the token. src/main/credentials/forge.test.ts forge}
- {**S26** While no forge is connected, the Crear repo dialog shall say «Conecta GitHub o GitLab en Ajustes» and keep Crear disabled; otherwise it shall offer only the connected forges, with «Clonar y añadir a Atril» unticked. src/renderer/settings/createrepo.test.ts the}

## work-inbox

Governs: `src/main/jira/** src/renderer/inbox/**`

- {**I1** When the inbox refreshes, Atril shall call `GET /rest/api/3/search/jql` once with the JQL in Constraints. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts queries}
- {**I2** When the API returns issues, Atril shall list each issue's key, summary, type and status. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts parses}
- {**I3** If no Jira token is saved, or the API rejects it, then the inbox shall show "Conecta Jira en Ajustes" with a link, and shall never ask for the token anywhere but Ajustes. src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts inbox}
- {**I4** When the person starts a task whose project and component have no remembered repo, Atril shall ask for one and remember it for the next task of that project and component. src/main/jira/start.test.ts remembers}
- {**I5** When the dialog opens, Atril shall propose the issue key exactly as Jira gives it (`WEB-3535`) as the branch name. src/main/jira/start.test.ts proposes}
- {**I6** When Start is confirmed, Atril shall launch `claude` with the bundled Libretto plugin, its hooks and the prompt `/libretto:libretto-flow <KEY>` in the new workspace's agent session — the plugin-namespaced name observed in box 4, because the bare `/libretto-flow` exists only where Libretto is installed globally. src/main/jira/start.test.ts start}
- {**I7** If an issue key does not match `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$`, then Atril shall refuse to start it. src/main/jira/start.test.ts refuses}
- {**I8** If the In Progress transition fails, then Atril shall keep the workspace and agent running and show the error. src/main/jira/start.test.ts transition}
- {**I9** While a workspace record carries a task's key, the inbox shall show that workspace instead of Start, also after a restart. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts task}
- {**I10** If the proposed branch already exists in the repo, or its worktree path exists, then the dialog shall say so and propose the key with the first free letter suffix: `B`, `C`, `D`… (`WEB-3535B`), as the team does. src/main/jira/start.test.ts proposes}
- {**I11** When the inbox shows tasks, Atril shall group them: status category `new` → Por empezar; `indeterminate` whose status name says in progress → En curso; any other `indeterminate` → En revisión y despliegue, folded by default. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts groups}
- {**I12** While the Trabajo screen is shown, the sidebar shall show the running work first and the Jira tasks only as a one-line summary of counts that opens the Tareas screen. src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts sidebar}
- {**I13** When a board is picked, the inbox shall group the tasks by its columns, in the board's order, matching each task's status id to the column that lists it, every column unfolded; empty columns shall not appear. (One proof holds both promises: main computes the order and the filtering in one pass, and the test asserts both on one result.) src/main/jira/board.test.ts groups}
- {**I14** If a task's status is in no column of the picked board, then it shall go to «Fuera del tablero», after every column, folded. src/main/jira/board.test.ts tasks}
- {**I15** While no board is picked, the Tareas screen shall keep the status-category groups and show «Elige tu tablero en Ajustes para ver sus columnas» with a link to Ajustes. src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts no}
- {**I16** If the board id is not a positive integer, then Atril shall refuse it before any request. src/main/jira/board.test.ts refuses}
- {**I17** While a board is picked, the sidebar summary shall count the first column's tasks as "por empezar" and the tasks of every other column as "en curso" («Fuera del tablero» counts in neither). src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts summary}
- {**I18** If reading the picked board fails (timeout, 403, 404), then the inbox shall fall back to the status-category groups and show «No se pudo leer el tablero (<status>)». src/main/jira/board.test.ts board}
- {**I19** Whether or not a board is picked, the inbox shall list only issues from the search with `assignee = currentUser()`, and shall never request the board's own issues. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts only}
- {**I20** When the person clicks Empezar on a task whose project and component have a remembered repo and whose proposed branch is free, Atril shall start it without the dialog and without a `--model` flag. src/renderer/nextup.test.ts one}
- {**I21** When the person ⌥-clicks Empezar, or the project has no remembered repo, or the proposed branch is taken, Atril shall open the Start dialog. src/renderer/nextup.test.ts option}
- {**I22** When the person writes a task in «Nueva tarea», picks a repo and presses Empezar, Atril shall open a workspace on the shown branch with the chosen model, passing the text as the task with agent `claude`, and show it in Trabajo. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I23** While the dialog is «Nueva tarea» and the text is empty or only spaces, Empezar shall be disabled; in both dialogs the text area shall accept at most 2000 characters. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I25** If no repo is registered, then the dialog shall say «Añade un repo en Ajustes → Repos», offer «Ir a Ajustes» which closes the dialog and shows Ajustes, and Empezar shall be disabled. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I26** While Jira is not connected (I3), «Nueva tarea» shall still be shown and open the dialog. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts own}
- {**I24** While the person has not edited the branch, the branch shall be the first five words of the text, a word being a run of `[a-z0-9]` after lower-casing and removing accents, joined by hyphens, at most 40 characters with no trailing hyphen («Añadir filtro de Laboratorios» → `anadir-filtro-de-laboratorios`; «fix: bug-in api, ya» → `fix-bug-in-api-ya`); once the person changes the field in any way, it shall stay as they left it. src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts branch}
- {**I27** When the person starts from «Nuevo trabajo», Atril shall open the workspace with the text as its task when the text is not blank (as I22), and with no task — plain Claude — when it is blank; Empezar needs only a repo and a branch there. (One proof holds both: the test starts one with text and one without and checks each call.) src/renderer/inbox/owntask.test.ts new}

## workspaces

Governs: `src/main/** src/preload/** src/renderer/** resources/** !src/main/jira/** !src/renderer/inbox/** !src/main/flow/** !src/renderer/flow/** !src/main/credentials/** !src/renderer/settings/**`

- {**W1** When a repo is registered and none of the three signals is found, Atril shall set its mode to `worktree`. src/main/repos.test.ts chooses}
- {**W2** If the checkout holds a git-ignored file outside dependency, build and editor noise (`node_modules`, `vendor`, `dist`, `build`, `.cache`, `.next`, `coverage`, `tmp`, `.idea`, `.vscode`, `.DS_Store`, `*.log`), then Atril shall set the mode to `in-place` and name that file as the reason. Only files count — entries of `git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard --directory` that do not end in `/`; ignored folders (build output, tool caches) are never a signal. Noise names match at any depth. src/main/repos.test.ts chooses}
- {**W3** If every `node_modules` and `vendor` directory, at any depth, together exceed 2 GB, then Atril shall set the mode to `in-place` and say so. src/main/repos.test.ts chooses}
- {**W4** Where the person has set a repo's mode, Atril shall use it instead of detection, across restarts. src/main/repos.test.ts person}
- {**W5** When a workspace opens in `worktree` mode, Atril shall run `git worktree add` at `~/.atril/wt/<repo>/<branch>` on a new branch. src/main/workspaces.test.ts creates}
- {**W6** If a branch name fails `git check-ref-format --branch`, then Atril shall refuse before running any other command. src/main/workspaces.test.ts refuses}
- {**W7** While an `in-place` repo has an open workspace, Atril shall refuse to open a second one in that repo. src/main/workspaces.test.ts refuses}
- {**W8** If the main checkout has uncommitted changes, then opening an `in-place` workspace shall refuse and change nothing. src/main/workspaces.test.ts in-place}
- {**W9** When an `in-place` workspace is closed, Atril shall check out the previous branch from its workspace record; if the branch has uncommitted changes, it shall refuse instead. src/main/workspaces.test.ts in-place}
- {**W10** If a worktree has uncommitted changes, then Atril shall refuse to remove it and say to commit or discard first; a clean worktree is removed with `git worktree remove` (never a recursive delete) and its agent session ended. src/main/workspaces.test.ts refuses}
- {**W11** When a workspace opens, Atril shall write its workspace record and start its agent in a tmux session named `atril-<workspace id>` with `remain-on-exit on`, recording the agent's pane id. src/main/tmux.test.ts starts}
- {**W12** When Atril starts, it shall show every workspace record, attach to its tmux session when one exists, and start no new agent; a record whose session is gone shows `stopped`. src/main/tmux.test.ts reattaches}
- {**W13** When the person splits a pane, Atril shall add a tmux pane to that session. src/main/tmux.test.ts split}
- {**W14** When a Claude hook reports a `Notification` event for a session, Atril shall set its agent state to `needs-you`. src/main/status.test.ts claude}
- {**W15** When a session enters `needs-you`, Atril shall show one macOS notification, and no other until the session leaves that state. src/main/status.test.ts notifies}
- {**W16** If the agent's pane (by its recorded pane id) is dead or missing, Atril shall set the agent state to `stopped`; other panes of the session do not count. src/main/status.test.ts exited}
- {**W17** When the usage endpoint answers, Atril shall show the Claude 5 h and 7 d percentages and reset times it returns. src/main/usage.test.ts parses}
- {**W18** The OAuth token shall never appear in Atril's log, in any IPC message to the renderer, or in any file under `~/.atril/`; the runner shall not log the stdout of a command marked secret. src/main/usage.test.ts token}
- {**W20** If a usage source cannot be read, then Atril shall show "—" with the reason. src/main/usage.test.ts missing}
- {**W21** If git, tmux, claude or jira is missing or fails its version command — `-V` for tmux, `version` for jira, `--version` for the rest — then Atril shall name it with its install command — git `xcode-select --install`, tmux `brew install tmux`, claude `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash`, jira `brew install ankitpokhrel/jira-cli/jira-cli` — and keep the rest of the app working. src/main/doctor.test.ts names}
- {**W22** The sidebar, panes and every button shall be reachable by keyboard — `⌘L` moves focus from the terminal to the sidebar and `⌘J` to the right panel, as menu accelerators the terminal never receives — and every state colour shall carry a text label. src/renderer/a11y.test.ts states}
- {**W23** When Atril launches for the first time, it shall run the tutorial, highlighting each element in turn with its explanation. src/renderer/tutorial.test.ts first}
- {**W24** When the person skips or finishes the tutorial, Atril shall not run it again on launch, and shall reopen it from Help → Tutorial. src/renderer/tutorial.test.ts tutorial}
- {**W25** While the tutorial runs, it shall be operable by keyboard alone (next, back, skip). src/renderer/tutorial.test.ts tutorial}
- {**W28** When the person clicks a sidebar section's title, Atril shall fold or unfold that section, keep its count visible, and remember the state across restarts. src/renderer/sidebar.test.ts section}
- {**W29** When Atril starts a Claude agent, it shall pass `--plugin-dir` with the Libretto copy bundled in the app, so the flow works on a machine where Libretto was never installed. src/main/agent.test.ts claude}
- {**W30** The bundled Libretto shall carry its `LICENSE`, `THIRD-PARTY.md` and every licence file under `licenses/`, and the version it was copied from. src/main/libretto-bundle.test.ts bundle}
- {**W31** When Atril starts a Claude agent in a workspace it created, the agent shall not stop at Claude Code's folder-trust prompt. src/main/agent.test.ts claude}
- {**W32** While one or more tools have problems, the top bar shall show a single chip with their count, and the full list with install commands only when the chip is opened. src/renderer/doctor.test.ts problems}
- {**W33** When Atril starts a Claude agent, the agent shall load the person's own user and project skills, commands, agents and plugins as well as the bundled Libretto: Atril adds `--plugin-dir` and never passes `--setting-sources`, `--bare` or anything else that drops them. src/main/agent.test.ts claude}
- {**W34** Where the person picks a model in Start or in "Nuevo trabajo", Atril shall launch Claude with `--model <alias>` (`opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku`; no flag for "Por defecto"), store it in the workspace record, and show it on the workspace row. Fable is not offered. src/main/agent.test.ts chosen}
- {**W35** Atril shall offer three themes in Ajustes — Claro, Oscuro and Automático (default, follows macOS); the choice persists across restarts, Automático switches live when the system appearance changes, and every theme keeps text contrast at 4.5:1 or more. src/renderer/theme.test.ts theme}
- {**W36** If the main checkout of an in-place workspace is no longer on that workspace's branch when it is closed, then Atril shall refuse, say which branch it is on, and move nothing. src/main/workspaces.test.ts in-place}
- {**W37** If reading usage fails (429, network) after a successful read, then Atril shall keep showing the last good values marked with their age, and double the wait before the next try (up to 10 min); the first success returns to every 60 s. src/main/usage.test.ts rate}
- {**W38** When the person clicks a needs-you notification, Atril shall show the Trabajo screen with that workspace selected, whatever screen was open. src/renderer/a11y.test.ts notification}
- {**W26** When a Claude hook reports `Stop` for a session, Atril shall set its agent state to `needs-you`; when it reports `UserPromptSubmit`, to `working`. src/main/status.test.ts stop}
- {**W27** When a session leaves `needs-you` and enters it again, Atril shall notify again. src/main/status.test.ts re-entering}
- {**A1** When a Claude hook fires, Atril shall append one line `{at, kind, text}` of at most 200 characters to the session's activity file, and never write the hook's raw payload. src/main/activity.test.ts hook}
- {**A2** When PreToolUse reports Read, Edit, Write, Bash, Grep/Glob or Task, the line shall read «Leyendo <file>», «Editando <file>», «Escribiendo <file>», «Ejecutando <first 60 chars of the command>», «Buscando <pattern>» or «Lanzando un subagente: <first 80 characters of the description>»; any other tool shall show its name. src/main/activity.test.ts summarises}
- {**A3** If PostToolUse reports a Bash command that failed — a non-zero exit code, an error or an interruption in the tool response — then the line shall read «✗ <first 60 chars> falló». src/main/activity.test.ts failed}
- {**A4** When a Notification hook fires, the line and the macOS notification body shall carry the agent's message («Te pregunta: …»); when a Stop hook fires, the body shall carry A5's «Claude dice: …». The hook writes that text into the state file it writes, so the body always belongs to the event that changed the state. src/main/activity.test.ts notification}
- {**A5** When a Stop hook fires, the line shall quote, within A1's 200-character cap, the start of the last assistant text in the transcript as «Claude dice: …». src/main/activity.test.ts stop}
- {**A6** The activity file shall keep at most its last 200 lines. src/main/activity.test.ts activity}
- {**A8** When UserPromptSubmit fires, the line shall read «Le has escrito: <first 80 characters of the prompt>», and PreToolUse / PostToolUse shall set the agent state to `working`. src/main/activity.test.ts prompt}
- {**W39** When an agent exits as soon as it starts, its session shall remain with the dead pane (state `stopped`): Atril sets the session's options on an idle pane and only then starts the agent in it (found 9 nov as a race that failed a test under load). src/main/tmux.test.ts an}
- {**A7** While a workspace is selected, the Actividad tab shall list its lines newest first and update live, and every workspace row shall show its latest line. (One proof holds both: the test pushes two lines for two workspaces and asserts the feed order and each row's latest line on the same render.) src/renderer/activity.test.ts feed}
- {**N1** The «Qué me toca» list shall order agents in `needs-you` by how long they have been waiting (oldest first), then the tasks with no open workspace from the first board column — or from «Por empezar» when there is no board or it cannot be read (I18) — in Jira's order. src/main/nextup.test.ts orders}
- {**N2** While Trabajo or Tareas is shown and the list is not empty, ⌘↩ shall open its first item — the workspace for an agent, the Start for a task, or Tareas when that task is not loaded yet; otherwise the menu item is disabled. src/renderer/nextup.test.ts command}
- {**N3** When the person replies to a needs-you notification, Atril shall type the reply into that workspace's agent pane as literal text followed by Enter, without bringing Atril to the front; it shall send nothing for an empty reply, and if the workspace or its pane no longer exists it shall send nothing and say «No se pudo enviar: ese trabajo ya no está». src/main/reply.test.ts reply}
- {**W40** When a workspace is opened with a task text, the agent's last argument shall be the single string `/libretto:libretto-flow <trimmed text>`; a text holding `$(…)`, `;`, both kinds of quote, a newline, or starting with `--` shall arrive byte for byte, as that one argument, and run nothing. src/main/tmux.test.ts task}
- {**W41** If the task is not a string, or its text is empty after trimming, longer than 2000 characters, or contains a NUL character, then `workspaces.open` shall refuse with «El texto de la tarea no es válido (máx. 2000 caracteres).» and create nothing. src/main/workspaces.test.ts invalid}
- {**W42** While the tests run, any Atril path (`ATRIL_HOME`, `ATRIL_CLAUDE_JSON`) without its env override shall throw instead of resolving to the person's home (found 9 nov: a timed-out tmux test kept writing after its `afterEach` deleted `ATRIL_HOME`, and left a workspace record in the real `~/.atril/workspaces.json`). src/main/paths.test.ts a}
- {**W43** While Trabajo is shown, the sidebar shall show «＋ Nuevo trabajo», which opens the «Nuevo trabajo» dialog, and shall not show a Repos section. src/renderer/sidebar.test.ts sidebar}
- {**W44** When Claude calls `AskUserQuestion`, the hook shall set the workspace to `needs-you` with «Te pregunta: <its first question>» as the text, and when that call returns (PostToolUse) it shall set `working`. src/main/activity.test.ts a}
- {**W45** When a PostToolUse for Edit, Write, MultiEdit or Bash ends and the workspace's branch has more than 400 × k changed lines against its base, with k higher than any k already claimed in that session, the hook shall claim k and print one `additionalContext` naming the exact total and asking Claude to offer a split into chained MRs at its next stop; otherwise — at or below 400, k not higher than one claimed, another tool, or no workspace record for the session — it shall print nothing. (One proof holds all: it runs `sizeNotice` over a real repo through 300 lines, 500, 500 again, 1300, 1400, Read at 2000, an unknown session, PreToolUse, and a second session jumping from nothing to 1300 and back to 500, and checks each result.) src/main/activity.test.ts a}
- {**W46** The hook's count shall equal F18's total for the same tree, and the renderer's warning threshold shall be the hook's. src/main/activity.test.ts the}
- {**W47** The `language` in `ui.json` shall survive a restart when it is `system`, `es` or `en`, and shall read as `system` when missing or anything else. src/main/i18n.test.ts the}
- {**W48** When the language resolves to English — chosen, or Sistema on a Mac whose first preferred language does not start with `es` — main shall build the menu, the notification texts and its own messages in English, keeping any `{detail}` as it came. src/main/i18n.test.ts main}
- {**W49** If the repo name is empty, longer than 100 characters, has a character other than letters, digits, `.`, `-` or `_`, or is `.` or `..`, then Atril shall answer «Nombre de repo no válido» and send no request; a name the forge refuses anyway shall come back as its `{detail}`. src/main/forge/create.test.ts an}
- {**W50** When a repo is created, Atril shall send the forge's create request for the person's account with the name, description, visibility (private unless public was confirmed) and a README, and answer with the web link and the forge's own path for the repo; a refusal shall answer «{forge} no ha creado el repo: {detail}». A public request without `confirmPublic` shall be refused in main with «Un repo público necesita tu confirmación.» and send nothing, and no request to a forge shall follow a redirect. src/main/forge/create.test.ts creates}
- {**W51** When cloning is asked, Atril shall refuse before cloning if `<folder>/<path>` exists; otherwise clone the SSH URL there and register it (with the suggested id when the derived one is taken); if the clone fails it shall register nothing and answer with the `git clone` command to run by hand; no command Atril runs, nor its environment, shall contain the token or any variable from the person's shell beyond PATH, HOME, USER, LANG, SSH_AUTH_SOCK and TMPDIR. (One proof per path: success, failed clone, existing folder; the token check runs on all.) src/main/forge/create.test.ts clones}
- {**W52** Main shall open in the browser only a link it returned from a create, and clone only into the folder its own picker returned last; anything else from the window shall be ignored. src/main/forge/guards.test.ts only}
